answer: An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 4 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. Since the comet hash is stored at intake, the crystal graph groups the endorsements and the garden audit exposes the collapse. An operator copying one text across 101 aliases thus pays for 101 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, because the hash is the same for all of them. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
